recipe_steps: 1. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine 1 cup rolled oats and 1.5 cups whole white milk.
2. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes until oats absorb most liquid.
3. Reduce heat to low. Slice 1 banana and stir half into the oats, reserving half for topping.
4. Remove pan from heat and let cool 1 minute (so protein doesn't clump). Stir in 1 scoop chocolate protein powder until fully dissolved.
5. Stir in 0.5 tsp cinnamon and 1 tbsp honey.
6. Transfer to a bowl, top with remaining banana slices and drizzle 1 tbsp peanut butter warmed 10 seconds. Serve immediately.
1. Pat thawed 9 oz flank steak dry. Season with black pepper.
2. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over high heat until shimmering.
3. Sear steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium. Remove and rest 5 minutes.
4. In same skillet, add 1 tsp minced garlic and 1 julienned carrot, stir-fry 2 minutes.
5. Add 0.5 cup edamame and 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce, toss 2 minutes until glazed.
6. Slice steak thin against the grain. Serve over 1 cup warm jasmine rice with vegetables, spoon pan sauce over.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (9oz) flank steak from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch.
Rinse 1 cup jasmine rice, cook with 1.5 cups water, simmer covered 15 min. Refrigerate in covered container; reheat portion Monday.

recipe_steps: 1. Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Cook 4 oz linguine 9-11 minutes to al dente; reserve 0.5 cup pasta water then drain.
2. Pat 7 oz salmon dry, season with salt and pepper.
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip, cook 3 more minutes. Remove and flake.
4. Lower heat to medium, add 1 tsp garlic and 1 tbsp capers, cook 1 minute.
5. Add 0.75 cup Calabrian sauce, simmer 3 minutes, loosen with pasta water as needed.
6. Toss linguine in sauce, fold in flaked salmon and 2 tbsp parmesan. Serve immediately.
1. Spoon half of 1 cup Greek yogurt into a glass.
2. Layer 0.25 cup granola and drizzle 0.5 tbsp strawberry preserves.
3. Add remaining yogurt, top with remaining granola, preserves, and 1 tbsp seed mix.
4. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1 cup chocolate milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 5g creatine to a blender.
2. Blend 30-45 seconds until smooth. Add ice if desired.
3. Pour and drink immediately.
1. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in skillet over medium. Crumble in 3.5 oz chorizo, cook 5 minutes until browned.
2. Add 0.25 diced red onion and 0.25 cup corn, cook 3 minutes.
3. Beat 3 eggs, pour into skillet. Stir gently to scramble, 2-3 minutes to soft-set.
4. Top with 2 tbsp cotija. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (3.5oz) chorizo from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday breakfast.

recipe_steps: 1. Drain 1 can tuna into a bowl.
2. Mix in 1 tbsp mayo, 0.25 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp capers, 1 tsp lemon juice, and black pepper.
3. Divide tuna salad over 3 rice cakes. Serve immediately.
1. Slice 8 oz pork tenderloin into medallions. Season with salt.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Sear pork 2 minutes per side, remove.
3. Lower heat, add 2 tbsp red curry paste and 1 tsp ginger, cook 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Whisk in 0.75 cup whole milk, bring to simmer. Add 1 sliced carrot, simmer 5 minutes.
5. Return pork to sauce, simmer 3 minutes until cooked through (145F). Finish with 1 tsp lime juice.
6. Serve over 1 cup jasmine rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (8oz) pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner.

recipe_steps: 1. Spread 1 tbsp almond butter on each of 2 rice cakes.
2. Top with banana slices and drizzle 1 tsp honey. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tsp espresso powder, 1 banana, and 5g creatine to a blender.
2. Blend 30 seconds until smooth. Serve over ice.
1. Mash 1 banana in a bowl. Whisk in 2 eggs and 0.5 cup milk.
2. Stir in 0.75 cup oat flour, 1 scoop protein powder, and 1 tsp baking powder to form batter.
3. Heat skillet over medium, brush with 1 tsp olive oil.
4. Pour 0.25 cup batter per pancake, cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip, cook 1-2 minutes.
5. Repeat with remaining batter. Serve stacked with 1 tbsp honey.
1. Pat 7 oz carne asada dry, season with 0.5 tsp cumin and salt.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over high heat until smoking.
3. Sear carne asada 1-2 minutes per side. Remove, rest 3 minutes, then slice into strips.
4. In same pan, warm 0.5 cup corn 2 minutes.
5. Serve carne asada over 1 cup Spanish rice with corn, 2 tbsp cotija, and 1 tbsp lime juice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (7oz) carne asada from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch.
Cook Spanish rice per box directions (1 cup rice, 2 cups water/broth, simmer 20 min). Refrigerate; reheat portion Wednesday.

recipe_steps: 1. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in wok over high heat. Add 8 oz shrimp, cook 2 minutes per side until pink. Remove.
2. Add 0.25 diced red onion and 1 tsp garlic, stir-fry 2 minutes.
3. Push aside, crack in 2 eggs, scramble 1 minute.
4. Add 1.5 cups cooked rice and 0.5 cup edamame, stir-fry 3 minutes to crisp.
5. Add 2 tbsp soy sauce, toss. Return shrimp, stir-fry 1 minute. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice with 2.25 cups water Tuesday, refrigerate. Day-old cold rice fries best. Reheat lightly Wednesday.

recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with 1 tbsp seed mix, 1 tbsp raspberry preserves, and 0.25 cup granola. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1 cup chocolate milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 0.25 cup oats, and 5g creatine to a blender.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Serve over ice.
1. Whisk 3 eggs with 2 tbsp milk and black pepper.
2. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in nonstick skillet over medium. Saute 0.25 diced red onion and 0.25 cup corn 3 minutes.
3. Pour in eggs, tilt to coat. As edges set, push toward center, letting raw egg flow underneath.
4. When mostly set, sprinkle 1 oz grated cheddar on half, fold over. Cook 1 minute. Serve.
1. Pat 8 oz sirloin dry, coat with 1 tsp blackened seasoning.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in cast iron over high heat. Sear steak 4 minutes per side for medium (135F). Rest 5 minutes.
3. In same pan, add 1 tsp garlic and 1 sliced carrot, saute 4 minutes.
4. Slice steak, serve over 1 cup brown rice with carrots.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (8oz) sirloin from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch.
Cook 1 cup brown rice with 2 cups water, simmer 40 min. Refrigerate; reheat portion Thursday.

recipe_steps: 1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Add 0.25 diced red onion and 1 tsp garlic, cook 2 minutes.
2. Add 5.5 oz ground turkey, breaking up, cook 6 minutes until browned.
3. Stir in 0.5 cup diced tomatoes and 1 tsp Italian seasoning, simmer 4 minutes.
4. Fold in 1 cup cooked white rice, heat through 2 minutes.
5. Top with 2 tbsp crumbled feta. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (5.5oz) ground turkey from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner.
Cook 1 cup white rice with 1.5 cups water, simmer 15 min. Refrigerate; reheat Thursday.

recipe_steps: 1. Stir 0.5 scoop protein powder and 0.5 tsp espresso powder into 1 cup Greek yogurt until smooth.
2. Top with 0.25 cup granola and 1 tsp honey. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1 cup whole milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 banana, and 5g creatine to blender.
2. Blend 30 seconds until smooth. Serve over ice.
1. Remove prepared overnight oats jar from fridge.
2. Stir well, top with sliced banana and 1 tbsp peanut butter. Serve cold or microwave 60 seconds if preferred.

prep_tasks.instructions: Combine 0.75 cup rolled oats, 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein powder, and 1 tbsp seed mix in a jar Thursday night. Stir, cover, refrigerate overnight.

recipe_steps: 1. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Add 0.25 diced red onion, cook 2 minutes.
2. Add 6 oz ground bison, breaking up, cook 6 minutes until browned.
3. Season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 0.5 tsp garlic powder, cook 1 minute.
4. Serve over 1 cup brown rice, top with 1 oz grated cheddar to melt. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (6oz) ground bison from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch.
Cook 1 cup brown rice with 2 cups water, simmer 40 min. Refrigerate; reheat portion Friday.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Cream & Rice
recipe_steps: 1. Slice 8 oz pork tenderloin into medallions, season with salt, pepper, 0.5 tsp rosemary.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Sear pork 3 minutes per side (145F). Remove.
3. Add 1 tsp garlic, cook 30 seconds. Add 0.5 cup chicken stock, scrape fond, simmer 2 minutes.
4. Whisk in 1 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp cream cheese until smooth sauce forms.
5. Return pork, coat in sauce. Serve over 1 cup white rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (8oz) pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner.
Cook 1 cup white rice with 1.5 cups water, simmer 15 min. Refrigerate; reheat Friday.

recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a cup.
2. Swirl in 1 tbsp strawberry preserves, top with 0.3 cup granola and 1 tbsp seed mix. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1 cup chocolate milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 1 tsp espresso powder, 0.25 cup oats, 5g creatine to blender.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Serve over ice.
1. Preheat oven to 425F. Mix 1 cup flour, 1.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt.
2. Cut in 2 tbsp cold cream cheese until crumbly. Stir in 0.5 cup milk to form shaggy dough.
3. Pat to 1-inch thick, cut 2 biscuits, place on baking sheet. Bake 14-16 minutes until golden.
4. Meanwhile, fry 2 eggs in 1 tsp olive oil over medium, 3 minutes.
5. Split a biscuit, layer 1 oz cheddar and eggs. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Optional: cut cold cream cheese into flour mixture Friday night, keep dry mix covered in fridge so biscuits come together fast Saturday morning.

meals.recipe_name: Flank Steak Teriyaki Stir-Fry with Rice
recipe_steps: 1. Slice 9 oz flank steak thin against the grain.
2. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in wok over high heat. Sear steak strips 2 minutes, remove.
3. Add 1 tsp ginger, 1 sliced carrot, 0.5 cup edamame, stir-fry 3 minutes.
4. Return steak, add 3 tbsp teriyaki, toss 2 minutes to glaze.
5. Serve over 1 cup white rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (9oz) flank steak from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch.
Cook 1 cup white rice with 1.5 cups water, simmer 15 min. Refrigerate; reheat Saturday.

recipe_steps: 1. Bring pre-made dough to room temp 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 475F with a baking sheet inside.
2. Stretch dough into a 12-inch round on parchment.
3. Spread 0.5 cup pizza sauce, sprinkle 2 tbsp parmesan and 2 tbsp romano, arrange 2 oz pepperoni.
4. Sprinkle 1 tsp Italian seasoning, drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil.
5. Slide onto hot sheet, bake 12-14 minutes until crust golden and cheese bubbling. Slice and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Thursday: mix 1.5 cups bread flour, 1 tsp instant yeast, 0.75 tsp salt, 0.6 cup warm water, 1 tsp olive oil. Knead 8 min, place in oiled bowl, cover, refrigerate to cold-ferment 2 days for flavor.
Saturday: remove dough from fridge 30-45 min before baking to warm and relax gluten for stretching.

recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Warm 1 tbsp almond butter 10 seconds and drizzle over. Add 0.3 cup granola and 1 tbsp raspberry preserves. Serve.

3. Beat 2 eggs, pour in, stir gently to scramble 2 minutes.
4. Top with 2 tbsp crumbled feta. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (5.5oz) ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast.

recipe_steps: 1. Warm 2.5 cups chicken broth in a saucepan, keep at low simmer.
2. In a wide pan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium. Crumble in 3.5 oz chorizo, cook 4 minutes; remove half for topping.
3. Add 0.25 diced red onion and 1 tsp garlic, cook 2 minutes. Add 0.75 cup arborio rice, toast 2 minutes.
4. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, letting each absorb before next, about 18 minutes total until creamy and al dente.
5. Stir in 2 tbsp chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 3 tbsp parmesan. Top with reserved chorizo. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 1 portion (3.5oz) chorizo from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch.

recipe_steps: 1. In a pot over medium-high, crumble 3.5 oz chorizo, cook 5 minutes until browned.
2. Add 0.25 diced red onion, cook 2 minutes. Stir in 1 tsp chili powder and 0.5 tsp cumin, 30 seconds.
3. Add 0.5 cup diced tomatoes, 0.5 cup corn, and 0.5 cup beef stock. Simmer 8 minutes to thicken.
4. Serve over 1 cup brown rice, top with 1 oz grated cheddar. Serve immediately.
